verdict.rationale: Claude Design is operated through conversation: you describe a visual to get a first version, refine it through conversation, collaborate in group chats with Claude, and hand off to Claude Code with a single instruction. Hands-on community reports confirm prompt-driven use, such as building a landing page and guiding SVG and PenPot workflows with prompts. Missing for 10: documentation of which non-generation operations (export, sharing, settings) can be driven purely by natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe a visual and Claude builds a first version, on brand.
you refine through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, or custom sliders (made by Claude) until it's right
Claude packages everything into a handoff bundle that you can pass to Claude Code with a single instruction.
Now you can use Claude Design from inside any conversation with Claude.
Used Claude Design to build the landing page for my side project over the weekend. Got something shippable in a few hours.
with correct prompts it even built out reusable PenPot components and design system tokens.
